content.comment_body: Hello everyone, Is it possible to access the circuit program from the [product_name] TD interface? If so, what are the steps? Right now, I only see Setup and Msg Config options in the menu.

You have the same access to the TD screen as with the main [product_name]. If your program doesn't have a password set, you’ll also be able to access the program itself. Use the DOWN button repeatedly until the date and time appear on the display. Then press ESC and follow the prompts.

analysis.insight_summary: The main challenge discussed was difficulty in accessing the circuit program from the [product_name] TD interface, as users only found limited menu options. This suggests that the interface may lack intuitive navigation or sufficient documentation about hidden features. A follow-up comment clarified access is possible without a password and shared technical steps, but didn't elaborate on the menu layout.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate easily accessing, reviewing, or interacting with the circuit program directly from the [product_name] TD screen using clear, straightforward steps.
